summary: Transportadora de Gas del Sur S.A. furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim consolidated financial statements and MD&A for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, prepared under IAS 34 with IAS 29 hyperinflationary restatement as mandated by Argentine CNV Resolution 777/2018. No transaction, corporate action, or special-situations event is disclosed; the filing is a routine periodic financial report by a foreign private issuer. No terms, board recommendation, advisor, or structural mechanics apply. What to watch: Argentine inflation accounting effects and tariff/regulatory developments, not deal arbitrage.
